# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric

# Drop rows with invalid revenue (6 rows)
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Display the updated shape
print(f"Dataset shape after cleaning: {sales_df.shape}")

# Check for the presence of a 'campaign' column or date information
# Since no date column is present, we cannot determine campaign start/end dates
print(f"Columns in dataset: {list(sales_df.columns)}")

# Look for any column that might indicate time or campaign period

print("\nNo column appears to represent time or campaign period.")"}
